name: Coder Development Environment
short_desc: Persistent remote development workspaces with automatic Coder setup
author: Coder
description: Coder with PostgreSQL, an automatically initialized administrator, general, Python, Rust and Flutter development templates and persistent workspaces.

form_fields.label: Administrator password
form_fields.hint: At least 12 characters; avoid dollar signs (RunTipi Compose interpolation). Used only for bootstrap; changing this field never resets an existing password.

form_fields.label: PostgreSQL password
form_fields.hint: Generated on installation. Do not change after PostgreSQL initializes.

form_fields.label: Default workspace name
form_fields.hint: First installation only. Existing workspaces are never renamed.

form_fields.label: Coder access URL override
form_fields.hint: Normally derived from RunTipi. Override only for a different reachable LAN/domain/Tailscale HTTP(S) URL, including port. Never localhost.
